steps: 1) FLUX.1[schnell] (Apache-2.0): generate background still from style_anchor -> assets/background.png
2) Wan2.2-I2V (Apache-2.0): image-to-video of background.png -> assets/ambient_loop.mp4 (fps 8-30 per asset-job.js)
3) Chatterbox (MIT) OR Kokoro-82M (Apache-2.0 fallback, already generated 8 wavs): narrate lesson intro -> assets/narration.ogg
4) Godot (MIT): open 07-app/godot, import assets; world.tscn consumes world.config.json; F5 to preview
5) Attribution: on enter_lesson, JS shell calls trackWorldView('elderwick-market') via 07-app/core/world-view-tracker.js
